summary: In the fourth design meeting, the team evaluated the remote control prototype against product criteria (fancy, spongy, innovative, and easy to use). The Project Manager reported that current production costs reached 22 Euros, severely exceeding the 12.50 Euro target budget. The team debated cost reduction measures, including removing solar cells, removing voice recognition, and using plastic buttons, or alternatively raising the retail price to 50 Euros. The team concluded that the prototype has high quality but low market acceptance at the current price, and decided to redesign a simpler product within budget.
decisions: Identified production cost of 22 Euros as severely exceeding the 12.50 Euro budget limit
Agreed to eliminate solar cells and voice recognition feature to save 4 Euros in component costs
Agreed to replace rubber buttons with standard plastic buttons
Rejected raising the retail price to 50 Euros due to low market acceptance
Decided to redesign the remote control into a simpler, straight model that complies with the 12.50 Euro cost budget

action_items.task: Redesign the remote control product into a simple, low-cost model within the 12.50 Euro budget
